entities.name: CoaBC
observations: Query sequence (419 aa) is 49.6% identical to reviewed Aliivibrio fischeri CoaBC across 95.9% of the query (E=2.73e-100).
Query contains flavoprotein PF02441 (residues 7–185) and DFP PF04127 (residues 203–412) domains, consistent with bifunctional CoaBC.
Homolog annotations assign phosphopantothenate–cysteine ligase (EC 6.3.2.5) and phosphopantothenoylcysteine decarboxylase (EC 4.1.1.36) activities; annotated cofactors are FMN and Mg2+.

entities.name: CoA biosynthesis
observations: CoaBC catalyzes two consecutive steps in CoA biosynthesis: formation of 4-phosphopantothenoylcysteine from 4'-phosphopantothenate and cysteine, followed by decarboxylation to 4'-phosphopantetheine.
